The first release of MetaHuman for Blender: bring MetaHumans into Blender with live face and body rigs, edit them, and send them back to Unreal Engine 5.

## What's in it
- **Character Assembler:** browse your exported MetaHumans by picture and build them from head and body DNA, with armature, meshes, LODs, shape keys, skin weights, materials with wrinkle maps, a face board, eye aim and live RigLogic.
- **Expression Editor:** reshape the neutral face, sculpt expressions as corrective shapes, edit skin weights and the expression graph, then save DNA or FBX.
- **Pose Editor:** edit RBF corrective poses and solvers, mirror, in-betweens and twist/swing setups.
- **Groom Exporter:** export Hair Curves to Alembic with Unreal's groom attributes.
- **Export to Unreal:** DNA files, a character FBX, face animation curves and an Unreal editor script that puts them on an Animation Sequence.

Checked in Unreal Engine 5.7: driven by the exported curves, Unreal's own RigLogic gives the same joints (within 0.0001 mm and 0.0001°), morph targets and wrinkle-map curves as the add-on.

## Install
Pick one of the downloads below. You need Blender 4.2 or newer.

- **Windows:** run **MetaHuman-for-Blender-1.0.0-Setup.exe**. It finds the Blender versions on your PC and installs into the ones you tick. Uninstall it from Windows' installed apps.
- **macOS:** unzip **MetaHuman-for-Blender-1.0.0-macOS.zip** and double-click **Install MetaHuman for Blender.command**. Its READ ME explains what to do if macOS won't open it.
- **Any platform:** in Blender, **Edit → Preferences → Get Extensions → ⌄ → Install from Disk** and pick **MetaHuman-for-Blender-1.0.0.zip**, or drag the zip into Blender.

Then press **N** in the 3D Viewport and open the **MetaHuman** tab, or use the **MetaHuman** menu in the top bar. The [how-to guide](https://github.com/kvriel/MetaHumanForBlender/blob/main/docs/HOW_TO_USE.md) walks through every tool.

## Requirements
- Blender 4.2 or newer (tested on 5.3)
- MetaHuman DNA files from UE 5.6 or newer. Characters, DNA files and textures are not included: bring your own, under Epic's licence.
